=== usage: no arguments
$ stuntcam 
--- stdout
--- stderr
usage: stuntcam <command> [options]

  up        arm a simulator (boots it armed if it is shut down)
            [--udid U] [--mode boot|launchd] [--reboot] [--grant BUNDLE]... [--source S] [--log] [--build DIR] [--skip-verify] [--allow-unverified]
  verify    canary verdict for this build on a runtime (private device set, cached)
            [--runtime V] [--fresh] [--keep] [--json] [--build DIR]
  exec      run a command (xcodebuild test, a CI script) so simulators it boots come up armed
            [--build DIR] -- COMMAND [ARGS…]
  service   notify-only helper: arms simulators Xcode/Simulator boot (launchd mode) and says when Xcode Run needs `up`
            install [--preboot U] [--only U]…|uninstall|status|run [--only U]…
  gc        remove private canary devices for removed runtimes, unused builds and unpacked canaries, and state of deleted simulators
            [--dry-run] [--keep-builds N]
  down      stop arming new launches (no reboot needed)
            [--udid U]
  status    every simulator stuntcam knows about: mode, build, latches
            [--json]
  swap      point an armed simulator at another build, effective at the next launch
            [--udid U] [LOADER]
  chain     extra libraries every app launch loads (e.g. another tool's loader)
            add|rm|ls [--udid U] [LIB]
  sentinel  crash/hang records and latches per app
            ls|clear [--udid U] [--bundle B]
  trace     an app's last 64 camera ops with host-clock times (shutter -> slot 12 -> still complete -> timestamp)
            [--json] [--udid U] [--pid N] BUNDLE
  env       print SIMCTL_CHILD_* exports for per-launch arming (Detox, scripts)
            [--udid U]
  source    switch the picture live, in running apps and the next ones (qr: a QR code of TEXT; webcam: the Mac camera)
            [--udid U] [--front NAME] [--back NAME] scene|image:PATH|video:PATH|qr:TEXT|webcam[:NAME]
  orient    set the virtual device orientation, live
            [--udid U] portrait|upsideDown|landscapeLeft|landscapeRight|auto
  doctor    check Xcode, runtimes, the host directory, the build and each simulator
            [--json]
  version   print the version and the commit it was built from (--check: verify the installed files and unpack the payload)
            [--check]
--- simctl
--- files
--- exit 64

=== usage: help
$ stuntcam help
--- stdout
--- stderr
usage: stuntcam <command> [options]

  up        arm a simulator (boots it armed if it is shut down)
            [--udid U] [--mode boot|launchd] [--reboot] [--grant BUNDLE]... [--source S] [--log] [--build DIR] [--skip-verify] [--allow-unverified]
  verify    canary verdict for this build on a runtime (private device set, cached)
            [--runtime V] [--fresh] [--keep] [--json] [--build DIR]
  exec      run a command (xcodebuild test, a CI script) so simulators it boots come up armed
            [--build DIR] -- COMMAND [ARGS…]
  service   notify-only helper: arms simulators Xcode/Simulator boot (launchd mode) and says when Xcode Run needs `up`
            install [--preboot U] [--only U]…|uninstall|status|run [--only U]…
  gc        remove private canary devices for removed runtimes, unused builds and unpacked canaries, and state of deleted simulators
            [--dry-run] [--keep-builds N]
  down      stop arming new launches (no reboot needed)
            [--udid U]
  status    every simulator stuntcam knows about: mode, build, latches
            [--json]
  swap      point an armed simulator at another build, effective at the next launch
            [--udid U] [LOADER]
  chain     extra libraries every app launch loads (e.g. another tool's loader)
            add|rm|ls [--udid U] [LIB]
  sentinel  crash/hang records and latches per app
            ls|clear [--udid U] [--bundle B]
  trace     an app's last 64 camera ops with host-clock times (shutter -> slot 12 -> still complete -> timestamp)
            [--json] [--udid U] [--pid N] BUNDLE
  env       print SIMCTL_CHILD_* exports for per-launch arming (Detox, scripts)
            [--udid U]
  source    switch the picture live, in running apps and the next ones (qr: a QR code of TEXT; webcam: the Mac camera)
            [--udid U] [--front NAME] [--back NAME] scene|image:PATH|video:PATH|qr:TEXT|webcam[:NAME]
  orient    set the virtual device orientation, live
            [--udid U] portrait|upsideDown|landscapeLeft|landscapeRight|auto
  doctor    check Xcode, runtimes, the host directory, the build and each simulator
            [--json]
  version   print the version and the commit it was built from (--check: verify the installed files and unpack the payload)
            [--check]
--- simctl
--- files
--- exit 0

=== usage: -h
$ stuntcam -h
--- stdout
--- stderr
usage: stuntcam <command> [options]

  up        arm a simulator (boots it armed if it is shut down)
            [--udid U] [--mode boot|launchd] [--reboot] [--grant BUNDLE]... [--source S] [--log] [--build DIR] [--skip-verify] [--allow-unverified]
  verify    canary verdict for this build on a runtime (private device set, cached)
            [--runtime V] [--fresh] [--keep] [--json] [--build DIR]
  exec      run a command (xcodebuild test, a CI script) so simulators it boots come up armed
            [--build DIR] -- COMMAND [ARGS…]
  service   notify-only helper: arms simulators Xcode/Simulator boot (launchd mode) and says when Xcode Run needs `up`
            install [--preboot U] [--only U]…|uninstall|status|run [--only U]…
  gc        remove private canary devices for removed runtimes, unused builds and unpacked canaries, and state of deleted simulators
            [--dry-run] [--keep-builds N]
  down      stop arming new launches (no reboot needed)
            [--udid U]
  status    every simulator stuntcam knows about: mode, build, latches
            [--json]
  swap      point an armed simulator at another build, effective at the next launch
            [--udid U] [LOADER]
  chain     extra libraries every app launch loads (e.g. another tool's loader)
            add|rm|ls [--udid U] [LIB]
  sentinel  crash/hang records and latches per app
            ls|clear [--udid U] [--bundle B]
  trace     an app's last 64 camera ops with host-clock times (shutter -> slot 12 -> still complete -> timestamp)
            [--json] [--udid U] [--pid N] BUNDLE
  env       print SIMCTL_CHILD_* exports for per-launch arming (Detox, scripts)
            [--udid U]
  source    switch the picture live, in running apps and the next ones (qr: a QR code of TEXT; webcam: the Mac camera)
            [--udid U] [--front NAME] [--back NAME] scene|image:PATH|video:PATH|qr:TEXT|webcam[:NAME]
  orient    set the virtual device orientation, live
            [--udid U] portrait|upsideDown|landscapeLeft|landscapeRight|auto
  doctor    check Xcode, runtimes, the host directory, the build and each simulator
            [--json]
  version   print the version and the commit it was built from (--check: verify the installed files and unpack the payload)
            [--check]
--- simctl
--- files
--- exit 0

=== usage: --help
$ stuntcam --help
--- stdout
--- stderr
usage: stuntcam <command> [options]

  up        arm a simulator (boots it armed if it is shut down)
            [--udid U] [--mode boot|launchd] [--reboot] [--grant BUNDLE]... [--source S] [--log] [--build DIR] [--skip-verify] [--allow-unverified]
  verify    canary verdict for this build on a runtime (private device set, cached)
            [--runtime V] [--fresh] [--keep] [--json] [--build DIR]
  exec      run a command (xcodebuild test, a CI script) so simulators it boots come up armed
            [--build DIR] -- COMMAND [ARGS…]
  service   notify-only helper: arms simulators Xcode/Simulator boot (launchd mode) and says when Xcode Run needs `up`
            install [--preboot U] [--only U]…|uninstall|status|run [--only U]…
  gc        remove private canary devices for removed runtimes, unused builds and unpacked canaries, and state of deleted simulators
            [--dry-run] [--keep-builds N]
  down      stop arming new launches (no reboot needed)
            [--udid U]
  status    every simulator stuntcam knows about: mode, build, latches
            [--json]
  swap      point an armed simulator at another build, effective at the next launch
            [--udid U] [LOADER]
  chain     extra libraries every app launch loads (e.g. another tool's loader)
            add|rm|ls [--udid U] [LIB]
  sentinel  crash/hang records and latches per app
            ls|clear [--udid U] [--bundle B]
  trace     an app's last 64 camera ops with host-clock times (shutter -> slot 12 -> still complete -> timestamp)
            [--json] [--udid U] [--pid N] BUNDLE
  env       print SIMCTL_CHILD_* exports for per-launch arming (Detox, scripts)
            [--udid U]
  source    switch the picture live, in running apps and the next ones (qr: a QR code of TEXT; webcam: the Mac camera)
            [--udid U] [--front NAME] [--back NAME] scene|image:PATH|video:PATH|qr:TEXT|webcam[:NAME]
  orient    set the virtual device orientation, live
            [--udid U] portrait|upsideDown|landscapeLeft|landscapeRight|auto
  doctor    check Xcode, runtimes, the host directory, the build and each simulator
            [--json]
  version   print the version and the commit it was built from (--check: verify the installed files and unpack the payload)
            [--check]

=== up -h
$ stuntcam up -h
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage of up:
  -allow-unverified
    	arm even if the canary failed on this runtime
  -build string
    	use this build dir (loader + engine pair) instead of the default
  -grant value
    	grant camera + microphone to this bundle id (repeatable; terminates it if running)
  -log
    	log stub and engine decisions under the host directory's logs/<udid>/
  -mode string
    	boot | launchd (default: boot if the sim is shut down, launchd if it is booted)
  -reboot
    	reboot a booted simulator into boot mode (Xcode Run and tests need it)
  -skip-verify
    	arm without a canary verdict
  -source string
    	scene | image:PATH | video:PATH | qr:TEXT | webcam[:NAME] (default scene)
  -udid string
    	simulator UDID
--- simctl
--- files
--- exit 0

=== verify -h
$ stuntcam verify -h
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage of verify:
  -build string
    	build dir
  -fresh
    	ignore the cached verdict
  -json
    	JSON output
  -keep
    	leave the private device booted
  -runtime string
    	iOS version (e.g. 26.3) or runtime identifier; default the newest
--- simctl
--- files
--- exit 0

=== usage error: service status -h
$ stuntcam service status -h
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage of service:
  -all
    	arm every iOS simulator that boots unarmed (on a shared Mac this includes other people's)
  -only value
    	arm only this simulator (repeatable)
  -preboot string
    	boot this simulator armed when the service starts (at login)
--- simctl
--- files
--- exit 0

=== usage error: service install
$ stuntcam service install
--- stdout
--- stderr
stuntcam: service install needs --only <udid> (repeatable) or --all: it arms simulators that boot without stuntcam, and other tools' or people's simulators may be booted on this Mac
--- simctl

--- exit 64

$ stuntcam source qr:x
--- stdout
--- stderr

--- simctl
list devices -j
--- files
--- exit 1

=== source: webcam without a helper
$ stuntcam source webcam
--- stdout
--- stderr

--- simctl

spawn U1 launchctl getenv SIMCAM_CONTROL

  | {"at":<n>,"build":"aaaaaaaaaaaa","mode":"launchd","proto":1,"vars":["DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES","SIMCAM_CONTROL"]}
sims/U1/current
  | 1 $T/simcam/builds/aaaaaaaaaaaa/libsimcamloader.dylib
--- exit 1

=== service status
$ stuntcam service status
--- stdout
not running
--- stderr
--- simctl
--- launchctl
print gui/<uid>/dev.stuntcam.service
--- files
--- exit 0

=== service uninstall
$ stuntcam service uninstall
--- stdout
uninstalled dev.stuntcam.service (simulators it armed in launchd mode stay armed until `stuntcam down` or a shutdown; its log stays in $T/simcam/logs)
--- stderr
--- simctl
--- launchctl
bootout gui/<uid>/dev.stuntcam.service
--- files
--- exit 0
